en: Itivuttaka 8: Ekakanipāta, First Chapter Thus it was said by the Blessed One; having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the abandoning of all things. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body (*kāyagatāsati*). This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the abandoning of all things. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the destruction of all suffering. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the destruction of all suffering. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the supreme security from bondage. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the supreme security from bondage. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this:

“Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of stream-entry. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of stream-entry. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of once-returning. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of once-returning. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of non-returning. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of non-returning. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of arahantship. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the realization of the fruit of arahantship. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the four foundations of mindfulness. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the four foundations of mindfulness. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the seven factors of enlightenment. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the seven factors of enlightenment. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of true knowledge and liberation. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of true knowledge and liberation. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the cessation of the influxes (*āsavakkhaya*). What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the cessation of the influxes. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the destruction of the taints. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the destruction of the taints. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the unconditioned. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the unconditioned. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the deathless. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the deathless. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of Nibbāna. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of Nibbāna. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state beyond all sorrow. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state beyond all sorrow. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of peace. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of peace. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of sublime peace. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of sublime peace. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of ultimate peace. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of ultimate peace. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of final peace. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of final peace. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of total peace. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of total peace. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of complete peace. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of complete peace. Thus it was said by the Blessed One. Having thus spoken, the Well-Farer further said this: “Monks, there is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of perfect peace. What is that one thing? Mindfulness directed to the body. This, monks, is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, leads to the attainment of the state of perfect peace. Thus it was said by
The Discourse on the Full Understanding of Conceit.
This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant; thus have I heard:
"Bhikkhus, one who has not directly known conceit, has not fully understood it, and has not detached the mind from it and abandoned it, is incapable of the destruction of suffering."
“Monks, by directly knowing and fully understanding conceit, and by causing the mind to fade away from it and abandoning it, one is capable of the destruction of suffering.
Thus the Blessed One spoke. With reference to this, it is said:
bound by conceit, and delights in existence;
not fully understanding conceit, they wander on in saṃsāra.”
They are those who come back to renewed existence;
and those who, having abandoned conceit,
are liberated through the destruction of conceit.
"Those who have overcome the fetters of conceit have transcended all suffering.
This meaning was also spoken by the Blessed One; thus have I heard.
